en: It makes the work so rewarding.

Hello. I shall have a look, then.
Oh, this cup is quite lovely.

Thank you for your purchase.
Please visit us any time.

The pleasure is mine. Thanks for the fine cup.
... right?

Hmm, quite a lovely piece.
Yes! That's our most popular piece.
Oh, hello! Welcome.
No. I merely dropped in.
Am I in the way?
In the way? Not at all.
You're a valued customer.
Browsers are welcome too. Come any time!
Not much on the shelves today, is there?

Even ordinary households now enjoy tea
after meals or at lunchtime, you see.

en: customers is such fun.
Coming! Who is it?
Huh? You're not from the workshop... are you?
I found this lying at your door.
Would these be your papers?
Oh! Yes, they are. Goodness, my invoices!
Did they blow out the window...?
I'm so sorry. Thank you very much.
Oh! Did I drop something else?
Oh, it's you.
Hello, how are you?
I'm always causing you trouble.
I'm so scatterbrained, I'm always dropping
or losing things.
You've even come to my home?
Since you're here, how about some tea?
I don't just sell cups, you know.
I know a lot about tea, too.
I can help you pick out items, too.
Come by any time.
Tea and whatnot... how carefree humans are.
You must be idle. I'll give you work.
Toil for my sake, as best you can.
Are you all right? That's quite a load.
Oh, is it pottery or something?
I'll be sure to call on you later.
Please take care on your way home.
This cup is quite lovely.
Sadly, I'm still single.
No sweetheart, either. Just one, please.
The pleasure is mine.

en: Hello. So you remember me.
I've come to your shop, as promised.
The pleasure is mine. Thanks for the lovely cup.
No, I just came to have a look.
I'm not in the way, am I?
Are these your papers?
All that I am,
I give to you...
Are you the new carpenter...?
No, apparently not. Indeed,
one can tell from your attire...
Have you some business with me?
Ordinarily, I never receive anyone
without an appointment, you know.
